```yaml
name: Release to Maven Central & Docker Hub

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        description: 'Run the workflow in dry‑run mode (no publishing or pushing)'
        required: true
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Validate required secrets
        run: |
          set -e
          missing=()
          for s in SONATYPE_USERNAME SONATYPE_PASSWORD GPG_PRIVATE_KEY GPG_PASSPHRASE DOCKERHUB_USER DOCKERHUB_TOKEN; do
            if [[ -z "${!s}" ]]; then
              missing+=("$s")
            fi
          done
          if [[ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
            echo "Missing required secrets: ${missing[*]}"
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          SONATYPE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_USERNAME }}
          SONATYPE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_PASSWORD }}
          GPG_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          GPG_PASSPHRASE: ${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}
          DOCKERHUB_USER: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USER }}
          DOCKERHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17
          cache: maven

      - name: Import GPG key
        run: |
          echo "$GPG_PRIVATE_KEY" | gpg --batch --import
          echo "pinentry-mode loopback" > ~/.gnupg/gpg.conf
          echo "use-agent" >> ~/.gnupg/gpg.conf
          gpg --list-keys
        env:
          GPG_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          GPG_PASSPHRASE: ${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}

      - name: Log in to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USER }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create Maven settings.xml
        run: |
          cat > $HOME/.m2/settings.xml <<EOF
          <settings>
            <servers>
              <server>
                <id>ossrh</id>
                <username>${SONATYPE_USERNAME}</username>
                <password>${SONATYPE_PASSWORD}</password>
              </server>
            </servers>
          </settings>
          EOF
        env:
          SONATYPE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_USERNAME }}
          SONATYPE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Capture current (old) version
        id: old_version
        run: |
          OLD=$(mvn -q -Dexec.executable=echo -Dexec.args='${project.version}' --non-recursive exec:exec)
          echo "OLD_VERSION=$OLD" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Build and test (dry run)
        if: ${{ inputs.dry_run == 'true' }}
        run: mvn -B -DskipTests

      - name: Build, test, and publish (release)
        if: ${{ inputs.dry_run != 'true' }}
        run: mvn -B -Prelease

      - name: Capture new version
        if: ${{ inputs.dry_run != 'true' }}
        id: new_version
        run: |
          NEW=$(mvn -q -Dexec.executable=echo -Dexec.args='${project.version}' --non-recursive exec:exec)
          echo "NEW_VERSION=$NEW" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Update documentation with new version
        if: ${{ inputs.dry_run != 'true' }}
        run: |
          OLD=${{ steps.old_version.outputs.OLD_VERSION }}
          NEW=${{ steps.new_version.outputs.NEW_VERSION }}
          echo "Updating docs from $OLD to $NEW"
          find . -name '*.md' -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
            sed -i "s|$OLD|$NEW|g" "$file"
          done
          git add .
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git commit -m "chore: bump docs to $NEW"
          git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Notify on success
        if: ${{ success() && inputs.dry_run != 'true' }}
        run: echo "Release to Maven Central and Docker Hub completed successfully."

      - name: Notify on dry run
        if: ${{ success() && inputs.dry_run == 'true' }}
        run: echo "Dry run completed – no artifacts were published or pushed."
```
